newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-League of Ireland premier division fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-League of Ireland premier division fixtures.

text.p: This weekend's national league of Ireland premier division fixtures. Shamrock Rovers only need one point from their game against University College Dublin at Tolka Park on Friday to ensure they avoid relegation. All kick-off times are given in GMT.
Shamrock Rovers versus University College Dublin at Tolka Park, 1845 GMT.
Derry City versus St.Patrick's Athletic at The Brandywell, 1830 GMT.
Bohemians versus Sligo Rovers at Dalymount Park, 1415 GMT.
Bray Wanderers versus Finn Harps at Carlisle Grounds, 1415 GMT.
Dundalk versus Cork City at Oriel Park, 1400 GMT.
Home Farm/Everton versus Shelbourne at Whitehall, 1415 GMT.
